CustomField.description: Set from the Form Builder's Reporting Settings. Whether a Form Submission Answer is written for this question: include, exclude, or blank for automatic. Automatic writes an answer for every question except the primary contact's name, title, email and phone, which are left out unless set to include, so a respondent's identity is not copied into answer records by default.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: include, exclude, or blank for automatic. Automatic reports every question except the primary contact's name, title, email and phone.
CustomField.label: reporting
